description: Hand-written responses for case null-handling, used to test the evaluation harness offline (pnpm eval --provider fake --recorded). They were not produced by a model and say nothing about any model's review quality; record real ones with pnpm eval --record.

findings.title: mentionTextById throws when the author is not among the participants
findings.description: find() returns undefined when authorId is not a participant; the non-null assertion hides it and `author!.email` throws a TypeError.
findings.impact: Notification delivery crashes for mentions by users who left the thread.

evidence.why: The result of find is dereferenced with a non-null assertion.

findings.suggestedFix: Handle the missing author (fall back to a generic label) instead of asserting non-null.

reasons: Scripted verdict: the cited code shows the problem.

summary.overview: Scripted summary for the evaluation harness (not produced by a model).
